concepts.name: Sensitivity Quest
concepts.pitch: A grounded fantasy about feelings. Industry is watching.
concepts.hook: Small, safe, and exactly what the board said they wanted to see first.

concepts.name: Gunmetal District
concepts.pitch: Men with jaws shoot other men with jaws. Nobody learns anything.
concepts.hook: Cheap to love, expensive to defend at a conference. The board will not be at the launch party.

concepts.name: The Listening Hour
concepts.pitch: Eighty minutes. No verbs. Four awards juries have already asked for a build.
concepts.hook: The cheapest thing you will ever make and the most respected. Copies are not the point, which is fortunate.

concepts.name: Sensitivity Quest II: Sitting With It
concepts.pitch: The same kingdom, one year later, and everyone has done some reading.
concepts.hook: A known quantity. The audience you have will buy it; the audience you don't still won't.

concepts.name: Body Type Infinite
concepts.pitch: The purple flagship. If you hired the choir, they own this box.
concepts.hook: Five slots. Enormous scope. The kind of thing an investor puts on a slide.

concepts.name: Last Call
concepts.pitch: One pub, one night, eleven ways it goes wrong.
concepts.hook: Systems-heavy and hard to demo. The people who finish it will never shut up about it.

concepts.name: Body Type Infinite
concepts.pitch: The one the wire was always for. Five slots and a launch trailer with a string section.
concepts.hook: Everything the board has been paying for, in one box. They will be so proud. They will be at a different studio by the time it ships.

concepts.name: Vignettes: An Anthology Of Care
concepts.pitch: Nine short stories, nine consultants, one shared engine and no combat in any of them.
concepts.hook: The highest industry ceiling available to you. The lowest floor of anything anyone has ever bought.

concepts.name: Hard Exit
concepts.pitch: The one you actually want to make. Big, loud, and completely off-strategy.
concepts.hook: The board approved this in a meeting they had not read the deck for. Do it before they notice.

concepts.name: Parking Lot
concepts.pitch: Everyday humans. Everyday violence. First time copies can save you.
concepts.hook: One location, one night, no publisher and no permission. The cheapest thing in the garage.

concepts.name: Night Shift
concepts.pitch: A petrol station at 3am and something in the forecourt.
concepts.hook: Slower burn, warmer audience. Streamers will find it in week three and it will not stop.

concepts.name: Roadwork
concepts.pitch: A hatchback, a ring road, and a very poor decision at a roundabout.
concepts.hook: Physics-forward and clip-shaped. It will be a meme before it is a game.

concepts.name: Parking Lot 2: Multistorey
concepts.pitch: Six floors. One ramp. The same shopping trolley.
concepts.hook: They liked the first one. Give them the first one again, but up.

concepts.name: The Lock-In
concepts.pitch: Four people, one pub, the doors are shut and something is in the cellar.
concepts.hook: Co-op is expensive and every screenshot has a friend in it. That is the whole marketing plan.

concepts.name: Linda
concepts.pitch: She worked a double. She is walking to her car. She has scissors.
concepts.hook: The most personal thing on the table and the hardest to explain to a storefront.

concepts.name: Parking Lot 3: Season Ticket
concepts.pitch: A stadium car park on a matchday. Forty thousand people and one of you.
concepts.hook: Third one. The audience is enormous now and so are the expectations.

concepts.name: The Ring Road
concepts.pitch: A whole town you have driven through. Roundabouts, a chip shop, a leisure centre with a cracked sign.
concepts.hook: The biggest thing the garage has ever attempted. If the scope eats you, it eats you in public.

concepts.name: Meat And Two
concepts.pitch: A carvery. A queue. An escalation entirely disproportionate to the wait.
concepts.hook: Pure clip fuel. Two storefronts will bury it in search and it will not matter even slightly.

concepts.name: The Big Baby Collection
concepts.pitch: Everything you shipped in the garage, relit, rebundled, resold.
concepts.hook: Six weeks of contractor time and the cheapest raw material on earth. It will make an obscene amount of money.

concepts.name: Parking Lot Online
concepts.pitch: Free to enter. The lot is now a place. There is a hub world and you can emote at strangers.
concepts.hook: No box price at all — every dollar comes from the store. The ceiling is the highest in the game and the floor is a lawsuit.

concepts.name: The Quiet One
concepts.pitch: No sequel, no hook, no roadmap rectangle. The one you'd make if nobody was counting.
concepts.hook: Fewer slots and no monetisation surface. Everyone in the building wants to work on it and nobody upstairs can justify it.

concepts.name: The Money Shot
concepts.pitch: You know the formula now. Ship it. Count it.
concepts.hook: The most expensive thing you have ever attempted and the one you understand completely.

concepts.name: Big Baby Forever
concepts.pitch: The mascot is a platform now. Seasons, passes, a currency inside a currency.
concepts.hook: It never ends, which is the pitch and also the warning. Trust is the fuel and you will burn all of it.

concepts.name: One More Parking Lot
concepts.pitch: Back to the lot. Same trolley. Older man. Same shotgun, heavier now.
concepts.hook: You could take the billboard money instead. You will not, and you know exactly why.
